properties.name: Norfolk Constabulary Headquarters (Jubilee House, OCC Wymondham)

game.notes: There is no sheriff or state tier in England — Norfolk Constabulary is the single territorial force for the whole county. UK firearms cover is vehicle-based (armed response vehicles), not a standing building.

properties.significance: Force headquarters and Operations and Communications Centre, shared with Norfolk Fire and Rescue Service. The force’s specialist capabilities are directed from here, including Broads Beat — the UK’s only inland waterways police unit, covering 120 miles of navigable water in the Broads National Park — and the standing unit that protects the Sandringham estate. Firearms, dog and roads-policing vehicle allocations are not published per station, so they are recorded here rather than guessed at a house.

properties.name: Gorleston Coastguard Rescue Team

game.notes: HM Coastguard is the state maritime service that tasks the RNLI; its rescue teams do shore-based cliff and mud rescue rather than crewing lifeboats.

properties.significance: The only HM Coastguard rescue team mapped in the county at the time of writing, sharing the Gorleston fire station site. Norfolk has more teams along its 90 miles of coast, but no published list of their station locations was found.
